test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All sandals are shoes.

Some heels are boots.

Some sandals are boots.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some heels are sandals.

II. Some boots are shoes.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c20e8de837f8c5f6bfae0fa3afb4d88f4afb1f5e968cdebecd353bf3bec48ba2.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some heels are sandals → Does not follow (As some heels are boots and some sandals are boots. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some boots are shoes → Follow (As some sandals are boots and all sandals are shoes. As whole sandals comes in shoes and has some part common with boots, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
